svg.aria-label: Deploying safely: a canary sends a small share of traffic to the new version and watches error rate and latency before rolling forward; blue-green switches all traffic between two full environments; feature flags separate deploying code from releasing a feature.

svg.text: flip all traffic; flip back to roll back
